title: On the group of automorphisms of the escaping sets of Hénon maps
summary: In this article, we provide an explicit description of $\operatorname{Aut}_1(I_H^+)$, the group of automorphisms of the escaping set $I_H^+$ of a Hénon map that induce the identity on its fundamental group. More precisely, for a Hénon map $H(x,y)=(y,p(y)-δx),$ where $p$ is a polynomial of degree $d\geq 2$ and $δ\neq 0$, we show that $\operatorname{Aut}_1(I_H^+)$ is completely determined by the degree and the coefficients of $p$.
